column1: Lessons from Century Club Companies|2016|0|0||6.5,7,7,7,7,8,6.5,7,7,7|Vicki TenHaken|Source misspells author's name. Research synthesis on organizational longevity, not a specialist operational curriculum. https://www.nwiled.org/article/nw-illinois-economic-development-annual-meeting verifies 2016 and research on long-lived US/Japanese companies. https://www.worldofbooks.com/products/lessons-from-century-club-companies-book-vicki-tenhaken-9780984898602 describes ten years of research and privately held smaller firms. D=7 low-confidence description estimate: ownership, continuity and changing conditions add comparisons; selected survivors do not establish sufficient causes of survival. E discounts selection and retrospective explanation. No negative theme predominates, no single historical period.

Cable Cowboys|2002|10|10|2002|7,8,7.5,7.5,7,8,7,8,8,7.5|Mark Robichaux|Source plural is a typo for Cable Cowboy, the John Malone/TCI biography, not a distinct book. https://search.worldcat.org/title/50582363 and https://books.google.com/books/about/Cable_Cowboy.html?id=fHq4AAAAIAAJ establish identity and 2002 publication. Insider access explains consolidation, leverage, regulation and cable infrastructure but invites subject-friendly framing. D=7 low-confidence description estimate: transactions and financing constraints add learning, personal detail has lower yield. T11 US-focused and T12 media/finance; approximate central endpoint 2002, low confidence. No veto established: reusable industry economics survives personalities.

Junk to Gold (Copart)|2014|10|0|2013|6.5,7,7,7,6.5,8,7.5,8,7.5,7|Willis Johnson|Founder memoir of Copart, titled Junk to Gold; source parenthesis identifies the company. https://books.google.com/books/about/Junk_to_Gold.html?id=czKeAgAAQBAJ verifies 2014, 188 pages and auto-auction business. Scaling salvage auctions and operational change offer transferable payload; founder attribution and personal/family narrative limit inference and density. D=6.5 low confidence from description. Faith or Vietnam episodes do not make the central purpose religious doctrine or war history. T11 predominantly American business/life; T12=0 operations/logistics. Approximate endpoint 2013, low confidence, rather than claiming every chapter ends then.

Dynasties of the Sea|2012|0|0|2012|6.5,8,7.5,7.5,7,8,8.5,8,7.5,7|Lori Ann LaRocco|The first book, not the 2018 sequel sometimes returned by metadata search. https://books.apple.com/us/book/dynasties-of-the-sea/id589590923 identifies original profiles of shipowners and financiers and 2012 release. Shipping cycles, risk and global trade link finance to physical logistics. Selected successful interviewees and industry access limit causal independence. D=7 low-confidence contents/description estimate: contrasting owners and financing constraints add learning, repeated success narratives may add less. Shipping is the organizing topic, finance auxiliary; T11/T12=0. Approximate period endpoint 2012. Not a technical shipping or finance manual.

The Operator|2000|10|10|1999|7,6,5.5,5.5,6,7.5,4,7.5,8,7|Tom King|David Geffen biography with record-label and film-business negotiation, ownership and relationship mechanisms. https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/93030/the-operator-by-tom-king/ provides description and opening sample; extensive personality/private-life material lowers fit and learning yield but business payload prevents V3. D=6 low confidence from sample/description, not whole-text inspection. T11 American media celebrity and T12 media; approximate central endpoint 1999. https://openlibrary.org/books/OL3941900M/The_operator documents bibliography 595–643 of 670 pages in 2001 edition. Original publication 2000, not reprint year.

One Buck at a Time|2017|10|0|2016|7,7,7.5,7.5,7,8,7.5,8,7.5,7|Macon Brock and Earl Swift|Dollar Tree founder account explaining the historical fixed-price business model, sourcing and expansion. https://www.rmc.edu/news/book-signing-brings-together-r-mc-community/ and https://books.google.com/books/about/One_Buck_at_a_Time.html?id=0fXwvQAACAAJ verify authors and 2017 publication. D=7 low-confidence description estimate: price constraints and procurement decisions add mechanisms, founder narrative risks selective attribution. T11 American setting and influence; T12=0 retail operations. Approximate endpoint 2016. Historical one-dollar model is not represented as a current company policy.

My Father's Business|2018|10|0|2002|6,6.5,6.5,6.5,6.5,7.5,6,8,7.5,7|Cal Turner Jr. and Rob Simbeck|Dollar General family-business memoir, not religious doctrine despite faith language. https://books.google.com/books/about/My_Father_s_Business.html?id=cDw0DwAAQBAJ verifies 2018 and coauthor. https://www.kirkusreviews.com/book-reviews/cal-turner/my-fathers-business/ describes inventory, expansion, family conflict and accounting scandal; a reader criticism at https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/55277838 disputes the author's accountability. E=6 recognizes self-exculpatory risk; criticism alone does not establish that the whole account depends on material falsehood. D=6.5 low-confidence description/review estimate: succession and inventory constraints add payload alongside values rhetoric. T11 American business, T12=0; approximate central career endpoint 2002, low confidence.

Down the Asphalt Path|1994|10|0|1920|8,8,7,7.5,7.5,9,8,8.5,7,8|Clay McShane|Historical explanation of the reciprocal development of automobiles, roads and American cities, not an engineering manual. https://books.google.com/books/about/Down_the_Asphalt_Path.html?id=hoFKI-yodUQC describes scope. D=7.5 low-confidence contents/description estimate: paving, regulation and changing street use add distinct mechanisms, local detail has lower transfer. T11 American urban history; T12=0 infrastructure. Approximate early-twentieth-century endpoint 1920, low confidence; not inferred from publication age. https://catalog.libraries.vsc.edu/cgi-bin/koha/opac-detail.pl?biblionumber=168265 documents 48 reference pages 229–276 within 288 pages. Later street-conflict scholarship disputes simple early automobile dominance, so not treated as settled causal timing.

The Cravath Firm & Its Predecessors|1946|10|0|1948|7.5,6.5,6.5,6.5,5.5,8.5,5.5,8,6.5,7|Robert T. Swaine|Three-volume institutional history, not legal practice instruction. https://sewardhouse.org/node/2174 describes the first volume and development of associates, partners and staff; https://www.lawbookexchange.com/pages/books/43172/robert-swaine-aylor/the-cravath-firm-and-its-predecessors-3-volumes-complete-set verifies 1946–1948 set and large biographical component. Use first volume's original year 1946. Staffing and professional-firm organization provide transferable payload, so no V3 despite extensive local history. D=5.5 low-confidence description/contents estimate: institutional evolution adds learning, detailed names and personnel appendices reduce yield. T11 US institutional history; T12=0 professional organization rather than political or financial argument. Endpoint 1948, low confidence.
